subject.why: Clearly recognizable brass lantern with the vine detail and glowing interior.

category.why: Object rests on a stylized surface with a clean gradient background behind it.

clean.why: No UI, text, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: Well-centered composition with ample margins around the lantern.

colour.why: Warm brass and yellow glow blend into the orange background, lacking clear color separation.

detail.why: Chunky stylized shapes with smooth surfaces and no micro-details.

style.why: Matches the reference style with soft shading, satin finish, and 3D volume.

fix: Change the background to a contrasting cool color to separate the warm lantern.
